scripts.//test: Always with coverage. The thresholds are 100 across the board and a suite that can be run without them is a suite that regresses quietly.
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:types && pnpm test:structured-data && pnpm test:lighthouse
scripts.//test:lighthouse:prod: Deleted. It was test:lighthouse with one deployment's hostname baked into it, which is deployment configuration and does not belong in the repo. Run the same gate against a deployed origin with: LIGHTHOUSE_ORIGIN=https://<origin> pnpm test:lighthouse
